threat_actor: Gamaredon (aka Aqua Blizzard; attributed by SSU to Russia's FSB 18th Center of Information Security)
summary: Gamaredon targeted Ukrainian governmental and military institutions throughout 2025 with 35 spearphishing campaigns delivering HTA downloaders, VBScript downloaders (PteroSand), and six new PowerShell tools, plus weaponizers for lateral movement. The group hid C&C behind third-party tunnels, serverless workers, PaaS and DDNS, abused legitimate messaging, blogging, paste and social services as dead drops, and moved data exfiltration to S3-compatible cloud storage. Detection should focus on the Ptero* tool names, the abused third-party service domains, and cloud-storage exfiltration endpoints.
